name: Puntadewa
source:
Puntadewa is the eldest of the Pandawa, as well as the crown prince of the Nayottama kingdom. He is calm and wise. Often seen reading a book in the library. As the crown prince, he is expected to act very politely to everyone. He loves his Kingdom very much.
